fields.statement: ArgentSea.Sql.csproj's PackageReference to Microsoft.Data.SqlClient (version 7.1.1) carries no Condition attribute: unlike the project file's two Optimize PropertyGroups, which are each conditioned on '$(Configuration)|$(Platform)', the SqlClient reference is declared the same way regardless of configuration or platform as written in this file.
fields.scope: The PackageReference to Microsoft.Data.SqlClient declared in ArgentSea.Sql.csproj.

evidenceLinks.note: PackageInvariantTests pass against the 2.1.0 project files at commit ea8e9aa3 (ArgentSea.Test 623/623).
